17-suite boutique on A1A in Ocean Ridge: a short walk across the road to a quiet public beach, with full kitchens and a heated pool.

Best for: Two adults who want a self-catering base a short walk from an uncrowded public beach, not a resort with beach service.

Pros and cons for you

Pros
  • Public beach about 2 minutes away on foot, across A1A
  • Top guest scores: Booking.com 9.6 (104 reviews) and Google 4.8 (245)
  • Full kitchens and free on-site parking for cars
  • Heated saltwater pool, gazebo and shared BBQs
Cons
  • Not on the sand: a road crossing and a short forest path
  • Road noise is the main complaint in the dated reviews
  • No elevator (Booking.com: upper floors by stairs only)
  • Small bathrooms, and some rooms have no outdoor space

Nearby

  • Ocean Ridge Hammock Park beach access · 2 min (Computed by geo.py from the address point; the public beach across A1A)
  • Oceanfront Park, Boynton Beach (1,750 ft per Booking.com; not routed)
  • Ocean Club of Florida (restaurant) (2,000 ft per Booking.com; not routed)
  • Boynton Inlet Park (0.8 mi per Booking.com)

Insider tips

  • The studio has one king bed and no separate bedroom; compare the 1-bedroom suite if you want a door between sleeping and living space.
  • Beach chairs and umbrellas are provided for guests (Tripadvisor listing copy); ask at check-in.
  • The beach is the Ocean Ridge Hammock Park access across A1A: it is open sunrise to sunset, unguarded, with an outdoor shower and no restroom.

We couldn’t verify

  • Year opened and last renovation not found; the official site says 'newly renovated' with no year.
  • Expedia rating not verified (HTTP 429 in the availability check), so it is not listed.
  • The Tripadvisor page was available only as a 2025-08-26 Wayback capture (394 reviews). The Google panel on 2026-10-18 showed Tripadvisor at 4.9 from 408 reviews.
  • Booking.com review dates are not shown in the hotel-page view, so two samples are undated, and no review in the last 12 months is visible on Booking.com.
  • Swimmable rests on a 2016 article ('crystal clear' water); there is no recent source on water quality at the park beach.
  • Walk to sand: sources give 2 to 5 minutes; 3 is used (the property's own figure). The public-access walk of 2 minutes is computed by geo.py.
  • Beach quality is judged from reviews and the park listing; no survey of sand or water.
  • Restaurant walk is not routed: the Ocean Club of Florida distance is from Booking.com only.
  • Elevator is from the Booking.com listing ('upper floors accessible by stairs only'); the official site does not say.
  • Kitchen type is from the studio listings on Booking.com and Google, and the official site's 'fully stocked kitchen'.
  • No on-site restaurant is listed on the official site or Booking.com; treated as none.
  • Photos come from a June 2023 upload (Webflow asset IDs) and were not checked against any renovation date. The booked studio is not photographed; the 1-bedroom suite is shown.

Beach notes
Delray Municipal Beach runs along A1A at the east end of Atlantic Avenue, with a pavilion and access mat at that corner. Ocean Rescue guards it daily (towers 9:00 to 6:30 in daylight time, 9:00 to 5:00 in standard time). Free surf wheelchairs are on hand. The renourishment (2.65 miles) was completed in April 2026, and WPBF reports 5 to 7 ft drop-offs in places, with sand being redistributed. The host says the beach is across the street; the Vrbo complex page gives Delray Public Beach as a 4-minute walk, a platform figure.

What reviewers say

Airbnb: 4/5 (15) · 8/10
Praised for
  • Hosts are responsive and helpful; hospitality is the most-mentioned topic on the listing

Complaints
  • Area safety: two of the three one-star reviews (February and August 2026) describe feeling unsafe near the street, and one reports a car break-in attempt. The host says the area is safe.

Recent trend
Mixed. Nine of 15 reviews are five-star, including April to September 2026 stays that praise the host. The three one-star reviews date from February and August 2026. The four February reviews split two one-star against one four-star and one five-star, the positives on location and beach access.

  • Lake Worth Beach CRA parks page: 10 Ocean Boulevard has the Atlantic beach front, the William O. Lockhart Municipal Pier, lifeguards 9am to 5pm daily, restaurants, shops and a municipal pool.Source: lakeworthbeachcra.org
  • Local guide: the historic Casino Building sits at this beach, and the pier's pilings make sandbars that give the stretch a reputation for consistent surf; the stretch's sand is quartz and coquina.Source: walkinthesand.com
  • FWC: sargassum abundance peaks in spring and summer months.Source: myfwc.com

Good to know

Know before you go

The search area mixes resort hotels, boutique and condo-resort stays, and many whole-home rentals, all taxed at the same 12.5% Palm Beach County stack. Public beach access is limited to a few parks (Boynton Beach Oceanfront Park, Ocean Inlet Park, Boca Raton's beach parks, Delray Beach's municipal beach, Palm Beach's Midtown Beach), while Highland Beach and Gulf Stream have no public beach access I could find, so a walk to a public access point usually matters more than the beachfront address. February is the area's driest month, with a 76.7°F average high, and sargassum usually peaks later in spring and summer.

Season and weather for the dates
  • February is the driest month: about 2.6 in of rain on average. The West Palm Beach airport 1991-2020 normals show a 76.7°F average high and a 60.1°F average low.
  • Water temperature in February averages about 77°F per third-party sea-temperature sites (not checked against NOAA buoy data), so swimming is comfortable without a heated pool.
  • Sargassum: FWC says abundance peaks in spring and summer, so February is earlier in the season. Check NOAA's daily Sargassum Inundation Risk map the week before a beachfront stay.
  • Presidents' Day is the third Monday in February, so Monday Feb 15, 2027. Fri Feb 12 to Mon Feb 15 is a holiday weekend.
  • Grapefruit League spring training opens Friday Feb 19, 2027 (MLB), and Jupiter's Roger Dean Stadium is in Palm Beach County. Expect more county-wide weekend visitors from that date (inference, not measured).

Sources: climatecenter.fsu.edu seatemperature.info myfwc.com cwcgom.aoml.noaa.gov mlb.com opm.gov

Booking, licences and minimum stays
  • A short-term rental (six months or less) in Palm Beach County needs a county TDT account and a Business Tax Receipt (BTR) number. Airbnb asks hosts to show both numbers on each listing.
  • A whole unit rented more than three times a year for less than 30 days needs a Florida DBPR vacation rental license (Chapter 509). Check that the listing shows a license number.
  • Boynton Beach requires a city BTR for short-term rentals, renewed by Sept 30 each year (city BTR page). A third-party guide adds a city inspection and a local contact within one hour; the city site did not confirm those details.
  • Other towns (Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Palm Beach, Highland Beach, Gulf Stream, Ocean Ridge) can add their own rules, and an address can sit outside the town named. Check the property address, not the town name.
  • I found no source giving typical deposits or minimum stays for these towns. Read each listing's minimum-stay, deposit and cancellation terms, especially for a holiday weekend.

Sources: airbnb.com www2.myfloridalicense.com boynton-beach.org myboca.us

Beach access, parking and chairs
  • Boynton Beach Oceanfront Park (the anchor park) charges $3.50 an hour with a two-hour minimum. Annual permits are for residents, veterans and seniors, and non-residents.
  • Ocean Inlet Park (county) stays free. Palm Beach County dropped a proposed $4 an hour fee for its 12 beach parks in September 2026, so check for any revival in a later budget.
  • Boca Raton's beach parks (Red Reef, Spanish River, South Beach) charge a daily entry of $40 on weekdays and $55 on weekends and holidays per car, from Oct 1, 2026. Gatehouses take cards and wallets only, with no cash.
  • Palm Beach town: Phipps Ocean Park was closed to the public from May 1 to an estimated Nov 18, 2026, so Midtown Beach is the open public beach. Midtown metered parking is $3, $5 or $7 an hour by zone through ParkMobile, and resident permit holders get two free hours.
  • Delray Beach: Atlantic Avenue meters are $4 an hour, side streets $3, city lots $2 and garages $1.50 (city announcement).
  • Highland Beach has no public beach access I could find: a 2025 letter to the Palm Beach Post says so, and the county was still reconsidering the Milani Park beach project. Gulf Stream and Manalapan showed no public beach access in my searches (unverified), and Ocean Ridge's beachfront has signed private-beach disputes (undated Coastal Star report).
  • Florida's wet sand below the mean high-water line is public (Fla. Stat. 177.28), but you must reach it through a public access point, not across private land.
  • Chairs and umbrellas: I found no city-run chair rentals at Boca's beach parks. A third-party guide says concessionaires rent chairs on the sand in high season (unverified). Ask each hotel about its chair policy.

Sources: wptv.com cbs12.com myboca.us townofpalmbeach.com townofpalmbeach.com natlawreview.com yahoo.com thecoastalstar.com floridadep.gov

Beach sand after the 2026 projects
  • Ocean Ridge Shore Protection Project: about 500,000 cubic yards of sand went onto a 1-mile stretch south of Boynton Inlet, including Boynton Beach Oceanfront Park, starting March 2026. The county says it gives 5-7 years of protection, so expect fresh, wide sand and no repeat in Feb 2027.
  • Palm Beach Mid-Town renourishment: dredging ended May 25, 2026, with nearly 600,000 cubic yards placed. Some accesses were closed during work, and the town said the sand was largely complete by late May.

Sources: discover.pbc.gov townofpalmbeach.com

Events in the Feb 1-28 window
  • Presidents' Day weekend: Fri Feb 12 to Mon Feb 15, 2027.
  • Lake Worth Beach Street Painting Festival: Sat Feb 27 and Sun Feb 28, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., free, in downtown Lake Worth Beach (Lake and Lucerne avenues). A stay on Feb 26-28 overlaps its busiest days.
  • Lake Worth Beach bonfires at the Casino and Beach Complex: Fri Feb 5 and Fri Feb 19, from 6 p.m. (city schedule).
  • Spring training starts Fri Feb 19, 2027 (see season section).

Sources: lakeworthbeachfl.gov mlb.com opm.gov

Taxes and fees

Taxes are typically about 12.5%. Whole-home rentals pay about 12.5% in taxes. Same 12.5% stack on whole-home rentals: 6% Florida sales tax and a 0.5% Palm Beach County school-capital surtax (both collected by Airbnb for Florida stays of 182 nights or fewer, per Airbnb help 2301), plus the 6% Palm Beach County tourist development tax (TDT). Airbnb's Palm Beach County page (help 2580) says the host must collect and remit the TDT, so the TDT is not in Airbnb's state-collected list. A verifier should add the full 12.5% to a pre-tax total. A listing with no TDT line, or without a TDT account number and BTR number shown, is a compliance red flag.

Hotels: 12.5% on the room charge = 6% state sales tax + 0.5% county surtax (from Jan 1, 2026; the older 1% infrastructure surtax was repealed) + 6% county TDT. Palm Beach County's TDT page says it applies to short-term accommodations and is an add-on to state sales tax. US lodging has no standard service charge, so service_pct is null. Resort fees are per property: a third-party 2026 summary lists a mandatory $53 plus tax per room per night at The Boca Raton (not on its official site, so unconfirmed), and most hotels here charge none, so check each property. No per-person tourist tax was found for these towns, so per_person_taxes is empty.

Every price on this page already includes each place’s own taxes and fees, so totals compare like for like.

Sources: pbctax.gov sutreview.com airbnb.com airbnb.com

The fine print

How we scored and what to double-check

  • Prices and availability checked Oct 18, 2026. Rates and rooms change often, so confirm the live price for Feb 5–8, 2027 before booking.
  • Prices are all-in totals for 3 nights, from our live checks only. Older research prices were never shown and were removed where they disagreed.
  • Who made the list: hotel, resort, condo resort, boutique hotel, all-inclusive, whole-home rental, within a 20-min walk of Public beach (15 preferred); within a 30-min estimated drive of Grandma's place in Boynton Beach (15 preferred), sleeping 2 adults. Travel times are worked out by our scripts from map routing (walks along footpaths; drives at free-flow speed scaled for typical traffic, so they are estimated drives, not ride quotes), never estimated by hand.
  • Borderline stays: estimated travel times aren’t exact (two map routers disagree by up to about 20% on drives), so a stay a little over a hard limit still counts as borderline: up to 36 min for your 30-min estimated drive limit to Grandma's place in Boynton Beach; up to 26 min for your 20-min walk limit to Public beach when no walking route was found and the walk is a straight-line estimate. Borderline stays are checked like the rest, labelled, and ranked after every stay within your limits; anything farther is ruled out with its time shown.
  • Fit score (10–100): each place gets 4 scores from 1 to 10, judged against what you asked for. The fit score is 10 × their weighted average: beach access 42%, walk to a public beach 25%, uber to grandma's place 25%, good-enough quality 8%.
  • Best value for the money: no other qualifying place with rooms confirmed is both cheaper all-in and a better fit.
  • Review snippets are paraphrased, not exact quotes. Ratings are shown on each site’s own scale, with a 10-point equivalent; we never average across sites.

What you asked for

Must have
  • Walk to a public beach in 20 minutes or less (ideally 15)
  • Uber to Grandma's place in Boynton Beach in 30 minutes or less (ideally 15)

How we checked availability

For each place we searched for your exact stay, Fri Feb 5 to Mon Feb 8, 2027, for 2 adults, on Booking.com, another booking site, Vrbo, Airbnb, each place’s own booking site, Google Hotels, Expedia and rental managers’ own sites. A place counts as bookable only if a site showed a public rate for every night (no codes, memberships, loyalty or package rates) and we saved a screenshot showing both dates and the price. The price shown is the cheapest such rate, all-in: room, taxes, service charges and any resort, cleaning or platform fees. We compare all-in totals, never pre-tax nightly rates, because fees differ a lot between places. Places we couldn’t confirm, and sold-out ones, are never top picks or best value, and the table hides them unless you untick “Only places with rooms for your dates”.

Checked live: 167 places. Rooms can sell out at any time, so book soon after reading this.
